waterbase.name: Water (Base)
waterbase.desc: The prism harnessing a weak power of water.

firebase.name: Fire (Base)
firebase.desc: The prism harnessing a weak power of fire.

earthbase.name: Earth (Base)
earthbase.desc: The prism harnessing a weak power of earth.

frostbase.name: Frost (Base)
frostbase.desc: The prism harnessing a weak power of ice and frost.

lightningbase.name: Lightning (Base)
lightningbase.desc: The prism harnessing a weak power of electricity and lightning.

darkbase.name: Base Of Darkness
darkbase.desc: A prism containing relics of the ancient Darkness spirits.

lightbase.name: Base of Light
lightbase.desc: A prism containing relics of the ancient Light spirits.

thunder.name: Thunder
thunder.desc: It is said to be the embodiment of atmospheric thunderstorm forces.

blizzard.name: Blizzard
blizzard.desc: It is said to be the embodiment of strong, cold blizzzard forces.

water1.name: Water I
water1.desc: A crystal infused with the power of the water element.

fire1.name: Fire I
fire1.desc: A crystal infused with the power of the fire element.

earth1.name: Earth I
earth1.desc: A crystal infused with the power of the earth element.

chaos.name: Chaos
chaos.desc: The embodiment of pandemonium and chaos.

bleed.name: Bleed
bleed.desc: Watch as the blood drips slowly...

tectonic.name: Tectonic
tectonic.desc: A heavy, earthen shard that vibrates with the grinding weight of the tectonic plates.

frostbound.name: Frostbound
frostbound.desc: This prism will freeze to the touch.

shockbound.name: Shockbound
shockbound.desc: This prism will shock an unworthy bearer.

prismlight.name: Prism Of Light
prismlight.desc: A prism that shines with a pure and radiant light.

prismdark.name: Prism Of Darkness
prismdark.desc: A mysterious prism that seems to absorb all light around it.

chrono_fragment.name: Chrono Fragment
chrono_fragment.desc: Nearby clocks desynchronize whenever the fragment becomes emotionally unstable.

overdrive.name: Overdrive
overdrive.desc: Violent arcs of high-voltage electricity violently crackle across its jagged surface.

abyss_ember.name: Ember Of The Abyss
abyss_ember.desc: A crystal of infernal crimson forged within collapsing abyssal faultlines below.

halo.name: Halo
halo.desc: Dim starlight drifts endlessly above and around this sacred heavenly crystalline relic.

magma_core.name: Magma Core
magma_core.desc: The molten, churning heart of an ancient volcano contained within a crystal shell.

cryo_core.name: Cryo Core
cryo_core.desc: An absolute frost is locked deep within, freezing the very air molecules around it solid.

nightmare.name: Nightmare
nightmare.desc: Formed from the collective dread of the subconscious, it radiates a chilling, dark terror.

seraph.name: Seraph
seraph.desc: Blinding, pristine radiance emanates from this flawless shard, illuminating the darkest corners.

epoch.name: Epoch
epoch.desc: A relic that anchors historical eras; peering into it reveals fast-forwarded echoes of the past.

calamity.name: Chaos: Calamity
calamity.desc: The absolute disaster and chaos; it is said to bring doom to unworthy bearers.

antimatter.name: Antimatter
antimatter.desc: When coming into contact with matter, it bursts into a huge amount of energy, cancelling out any real objects.
